name: Evil Days
overview: Scripture teaches that evil days are a reality believers must anticipate, as described in Ecclesiastes 12:1, urging remembrance of the Creator before such times come. The psalmist assures that those who dwell in God's presence will find protection and need not fear the dangers that accompany these days (Psalms 91:1, 5). Wisdom calls believers to hate evil and pride, cultivating reverence for the Lord as a safeguard against the evil way (Proverbs 8:13). Jesus warns that the path to life is narrow and few find it, while also foretelling wars and unrest, encouraging believers not to be troubled because these events must occur before the end (Matthew 7:14; 24:6).
